issues.title: Production build and localhost renderer are broken
issues.evidence: TS5097 during build/typecheck and Vite import-analysis overlay at /app/sablonlar: dist/auto-design-director.js imports ./strategy.ts, which does not exist in dist.

issues.title: RenderPlan, composers and layout engine are not on the Studio runtime path
issues.evidence: Production consumers exist in packages/design-spec, but no non-test app or edge-function consumer invokes composeDashboard, composeManagementList, composeForm, composeDetail, composeAnalytics, composeSettings or layoutRenderPlan.

issues.title: Renderer infers archetype from screen name
issues.evidence: PhoneScreen lowercases screen.name and uses includes(setting/form/detail/analytic/list) to assign composition.

issues.title: Renderer branches on palette identity
issues.evidence: PhoneScreen chooses chart family from presentation.palette and applies strategyPalette* CSS classes directly.

issues.title: Donut and radial chart families are fake or broken
issues.evidence: donut skips bar and polyline branches without drawing arcs; radial uses the same polyline path with larger point circles.

issues.title: Most StyleSystemProfile V3 grammar is not consumed by the DOM renderer
issues.evidence: Runtime adapter collapses PresentationSpecV2 to palette, cardStyle, density, navigationStyle, cardFamilies and chartTypes. Motion, typography roles, media treatment, grouping, surface/divider/status/data/interaction/empty/modal grammar do not reach runtime behavior.

issues.title: Canonical 42-screen runtime evidence matrix does not exist
issues.evidence: Current app cannot render; preset E2E only checks five gallery previews and one screenshot, not 7 modes x 6 archetypes with Studio renderer bounds.

issues.title: Runtime certification security is implemented but not proven live
issues.evidence: Unit tests and source checks exist, but expected POST /runtime-certification/session endpoint is absent and wrong-job/hash/expired/mutated/write/generation cases were not executed against deployed functions in this audit.
